outcome: foetal and maternal morbidity and mortality
cohort: All deliveries recorded in the Regional Health-care database of Castilla y Leon, Spain, between 2001 and 2013.
finding: The proportion of multiple deliveries in Castilla y Leon, Spain, showed a continuous upward trend between 2001 and 2013, significantly correlated with advanced maternal age and in vitro fertilisation, and associated with increased foetal and maternal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was significantly correlated with multiple pregnancy.
